notes.title: Patch 0.2.5 - Fluid Tank Block, Reworked Asteroid/Resource System
notes.notes: [p][b]Fluid Tank:[/b][/p][list][*][p]New block to allow for one-way buffering of fluids. Will facilitate priority sub-loops for fuelling. [/p][/*][*][p]Can also pickup fuel from your inventory in the UI.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629250/1c26016dfae14f8b28a9e4f2fcd5435aa9c52d6f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629250/f8d9ebda39f85a95bf956d8260e1b616608dbefd.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Reworked Asteroid Resource System:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Inverted the Copper/Iron/Aluminium asteroid and the Manganese/Silicon/Graphite.[/p][/*][*][p]Added different base densities for resources.[/p][/*][*][p]Added fuzz algorithm so blocks can have a range of values.[/p][/*][/list][p]Base Densities:[/p][list][*][p]Aluminium Oxide: 80,[/p][/*][*][p]Copper Sulfide: 120,[/p][/*][*][p]Iron Oxide: 120,[/p][/*][*][p]Manganese Oxide: 80,[/p][/*][*][p]Graphite: 120,[/p][/*][*][p]Silicon: 120,[/p][/*][*][p]Hydrogen: 200,[/p][/*][*][p]Oxygen: 200,[/p][/*][*][p]Thorium: 200,[/p][/*][*][p]Uranium: 200[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629250/a3a554ceb7f6a5f05fc4f6f759f17d8c53df5a2c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Options will now correctly load default state when new option is added to menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked inserter requestor system to handle slow insertion speed on fast recipes.[/p][/*][*][p]Miner resource lock bug fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Other various.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.2.4 - New Pipes, Hotkey Hints, Transporter Improvements and Bugfixes
notes.notes: [p][b]New Pipe Model System:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Pipe model has been updated with an omnidirectional state aware design.[/p][/*][*][p]It will connect up to pipes/producers/consumers when they are interacting. Showing their connections in all possible 6 degrees-of-freedom.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629250/894e3b715d7e257d8208a6e700b4f764e4ded251.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Transporter:[/b][/p][list][*][p]New and improved texture.[/p][/*][*][p]New billboarded item design for transporters. Items that are not grid-placeable blocks will now show up as a billboard sprite in game. To help with optimisation and differentiation.[/p][/*][*][p]Hotkey for reversing transporter direction in world.[/p][/*][*][p]Smart auto-merge transporter hotkey.[/p][/*][*][p]Items now stack in a 2x2x2 grid inside transporters to allow for better visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Hypothetical cube now shows state of transporter after placement - will help determine when placement will join with other transporters in the world.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Waypoint:[/b][/p][list][*][p]New Waypoint Texture + coloured shader effect. Say wassup to your only friend in space![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629250/2cfffbd05d0f920550e5363747d29ade0a8b73fd.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Artwork:[/b][/p][list][*][p]First new Icons from our new Art Designer, Riley! The in-game icons will be replaced over the next few weeks/months.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629250/a6bba2ccd3a9e34f3bf2bcbbfee9048cd91c225b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629250/c0a031a151f7107e62c01ea82193a295737e0e76.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Other features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Screenshot hotkey added.[/p][/*][*][p]Hide UI hotkey added.[/p][/*][*][p]UI Scaling added (with reset hotkey if state is scuffed).[/p][/*][*][p]Huge-Chest - Holds up to 100 item stacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved bind hints. Copy / Paste and many others. Can toggle these off in options.[/p][/*][*][p]Splitter omni model state (similar to pipes).[/p][/*][*][p]Added a directional override to non-directional blocks to allow for placing in a fixed line.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked splitter research tasks, and moved up right-angled inserter.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Miner productivity system reworked and fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Electricity system fixed and correctly tracks consumption.[/p][/*][*][p]First frame on focus no longer allows placement/removal events - to help with alt-tabbing in[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pipe-network spawning.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed negative rotation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pipe-connection bug in certain circumstances.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed splitter/transporter throughput.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed splitter/transporter item right angle movement.[/p][/*][*][p]Other fixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.2.3
notes.notes: [p][b]New interaction method[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ability to look past non-full sized cubes for interactions. This allows binds to target full sized blocks behind say transporters/inserters.[/p][/*][*][p]Popup indicator of possible actions when mousing over a block - helpful for newer players when learning hotkeys.[/p][/*][*][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Other:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Omnidirectional pipes (this was in the last release but no patch notes were written) (mesh is still bugged, but we will fix that soon)[/p][/*][*][p]Text size increased temporarily until we develop an integrated text scaling approach.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Filter inserters not work correctly, and no longer crash the game[/p][/*][*][p]Splitter state is now saved properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fuel Research Lab no correctly takes fuel from pipes[/p][/*][*][p]Other misc fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][b]This update will break save-games, apologies for that[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Huge Update, game is getting closer to release date
notes.notes:
Game has been completely rebuilt, including the UI, full parallelism etc.
Still more work to go before a demo is viable, but I will start to push updates more frequently now.
Jump in and see for yourself!
